annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that any flag that has no defined semantics for a particular frame type must be ignored when received and must be left unset (0x0) when sent. The preceding definition of “unused flags” and the following reserved‑flag clause do not introduce any alternative interpretations or missing constraints. Therefore the clause is not ambiguous.
